subject: S09 done (final): 0011, server clock, exam view, Results, scratch ink via S12b, settle() in exam.spec; full lead test-cmd green
body:
# S09 done: timed/exam modes, server-authoritative timer, navigator, Results

Commits on claude/naadi-shared: bebb371 (feature), ca9d972 + d70db09 (e2e hardening), c3e16bf (scratch ink via S12b's ink API), f7e7507 (shared settle() after every navigation / before offline in exam.spec, lead request; integrated with the full lead test-cmd: lint + typecheck + all vitest + 811 pytest green).
Alembic: 0011_exam_timing (down_revision 0010), single head; seg10 0012 / seg11 0013 chain on it.

## What landed
- **DB (0011, RLS in the same file):** `block_sections` (select-only for `authenticated`; four `_own` policies; every timing write is the API's), `blocks.break_used_ms`, `attempts.first_chosen/changes/answered_at` (backend-only). Added to the RLS coverage fixtures (SELECT_ONLY), live_check USER_TABLES (20) + "42 Naadi tables", db/schema.sql.
- **Clock** (`qbank/clock.py`, pure): deadline, pause/resume (timed only; exam = 409 `pause_exam_mode`), shared 45-min break pool with auto-start of the next section when spent, 2 s expiry grace, a missing/deleted row = expired (never fresh time), lazy evaluation from timestamps (a closed tab still expires). Injectable `app.state.now`.
- **API:** `POST /api/blocks` timed/exam with `sections` (count = per section); `POST /api/blocks/mock {mock1|mock2}` (always exam, fixed order, one section per seeded block, minutes_per_block from exam_rules); `GET /blocks/{id}/clock`; `POST /blocks/{id}/sections/{n}/{start|pause|resume|end}`; `POST /blocks/{id}/finish`; `GET /blocks/{id}/results`; `GET /api/exam/active`. Every block/question/attempt response embeds `clock`. 409s carry `error.code` (CodedHTTPException in errors.py).
- **Leak rules:** timed/exam answers are recorded, never graded until the whole block finishes (`correct` NULL, so S08's 0010 card gate stays closed mid-exam); only the running section's questions are served; explanations only after the finish (for answered and omitted questions); omitted questions are written chosen NULL / correct false.
- **Results:** % correct, mean/median time vs target, changed answers (right→wrong etc.), flags, per-question grid, systems/disciplines(or clinical sciences)/competencies with weak < 60 %, official weight overlay, last-10 trend, deterministic insights as `{kind, vars}` worded by `results.insight.*` ui_copy.
- **analytics/queries.py** (accuracy_by_node, time_per_question, score_trend); `__init__` re-exports nothing (seg11 contract). `qbank/exam_state.active_exam()`; `qbank/timed_blocks.create_timed_block()` for S11's diagnostic.
- **Web:** exam view (full-screen frame; header "Block x of y · Question n of 40"; timer = deadline − (now + best-RTT offset), re-synced on visibilitychange/pageshow/focus/online/60 s, nearest-second display on a 100 ms tick; break chip; Pause or "Pause is off in exam mode"; End block with confirm), 40-tile navigator (answered filled, unanswered dashed, flagged amber ring + glyph + word, current lime), tools (flag, highlight via CSS Highlight API, strike-out, lab values, four-function calculator, scratch ink, zoom/contrast), 5- and 1-minute aria-live warnings, start/break/paused screens, offline answers queued "will sync", stale-clock banner, Ctrl/Cmd+K suppressed on exam screens, shell chrome inert. Results page + review mode (filters all/missed/flagged/changed). Builder: Blocks chips for timed/exam, Mock exams group (from the pool response; `?mock=` focuses it, never auto-starts). `qbank_timed` ON.

## Tests
- pytest unit 534 passed (local; the only local red is the pre-existing uvicorn-logging test that also fails on the base); new: test_clock_unit (17), test_results_unit (7).
- pytest db 295 passed locally on a fresh stack (incl. test_exam_db: 17 — clock, grace, breaks/auto-start, missing row, pause refusal, leak probe over every endpoint, client cannot write timing/grading or select `correct`, flashcard gate after grading only, mock A, create_timed_block; S08's qbank db tests updated for timed modes on).
- vitest 197 (web) + shared/ui/ink green; biome + ruff + tsc + mypy clean; `pnpm gen:contracts` / `gen:requirements` no drift.
- e2e smoke (--retries=0): exam.spec 25/25 twice on webkit iPad portrait/landscape/phone-390, chromium laptop and firefox iPad portrait at f7e7507; qbank.spec green except S08's known Lab-values axe flake (reported 2026-11-16T22:3x to seg08, frozen-copy overlap).
- CI run https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43971260118 (bebb371): e2e chromium 6/6 viewports green; e2e webkit 635 passed, 1 failed = S08 Lab-values flake; e2e firefox: S09's only failure was the offline test's cut-off font fetch — fixed in d70db09 (verified locally on Firefox/WebKit ×2); other Firefox fails are agent.spec (S04). unit job red = seg07 test_quiet_logging; db job red = auth_stack.sh ci setup (both reported, not S09). Runs for c3e16bf and f7e7507 were cancelled by the old concurrency rule; I re-ran the f7e7507 run (43979737504) and will post its result as a note (not an update, to keep the task done).

## Checklist
- Copy: all exam.* / results.* strings are ui_copy keys in REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS, defaults regenerated, `exam` added to noHardcodedCopy ROOTS (passes). Server sends codes, client words them. ✔
- One lime CTA per view (asserted in e2e on results/review), status never colour-only (navigator/grid names + glyphs). ✔ Phone 390: no truncation/overflow (expectNoHorizontalOverflow everywhere). ✔
- No dead buttons: "Make cards from misses" disabled with a visible reason (S10); "Adjust this week's plan" hidden (S16). ✔ Keyboard shortcuts ignored in inputs/dialogs. ✔
- Leaks: verified by db leak probe + e2e probes before finish; mock answer keys never served. ✔ Clients cannot write server columns (tests). ✔
- Prod CSP: exam view e2e on the APP_ENV=prod server, zero console errors / CSP violations. ✔
- Screenshots (iPad portrait, iPad landscape, phone 390, laptop): test-results/screens/09/{exam-start, exam-question, exam-navigator, exam-end-confirm, exam-break, timed-paused, timed-offline, timed-scratch, results, review, builder-mock-group}--<project>.png in my worktree; CI uploads e2e artifacts.

## Decisions (lead to check)
- Timing in select-only block_sections; 45-min shared break pool; mocks always exam; explanations only after the whole session.
- Omitted questions count as misses and are reviewable after the finish; the flashcard gate stays closed for them (needs a choice).
- Highlights/strike-outs device-local (Dexie 4.4.7, cleared 7 days after finish); scratch ink is an exam_scratch ink surface `{block_id}:{n}` synced through S12b's API (c3e16bf; e2e draws a stroke and reads item_count 1 back).
- Timer display rounds to the nearest second (±0.6 s with a 100 ms tick) rather than up, to stay within ±1 s.
- Mock list and timed rules travel in GET /api/qbank/pool (no Courses/public-config calls from the Builder; seg06 dropped mock_exams from Courses).
- ui_copy cap raised 500 → 1500 strings (shared + S09 exceeded 500).
- Ctrl/Cmd+K suppressed by a capture-phase listener in exam/useExamChrome (seg07 never replied; no edits to their files).

- e2e: every navigation in exam.spec is followed by the shared settle(page) (and settle before setOffline), per the lead's Firefox font-race request.
